findings.finding: generation.job.create success is durable creation of DISCUSSING job, not COMPLETED generation outcome. generation.job.created is explicit listed event and cannot be NOT_APPLICABLE.

Generation created event has job/monotonic sequence, event type, emittedAt/persistedAt, payload/digest, appropriate optional artifact references and correlation/causation/trace. No dedicated exact generation.job.created payload schema exists in frozen resources: technical specialization required. No spec/plan/release/authority yet claimed by receipt.

secret.create creates record and first immutable CREATED candidate version. Activation/rotation is separate; no binding/runtime grant or automatic ACTIVE. Active version pointer absent/null until activation. Initial active epoch should represent no activation, but exact starting counter convention requires technical explicit addition.
notExistingAuthority: record status enum for unactivated secret

findings.finding: secret.create descriptor mandates outbox DOMAIN_EVENT and audit OPERATION_TERMINAL. No existing secret.created event name or payload schema found. Can define technical typed OPERATION_TERMINAL subject secret_record receipt using existing descriptor; cannot mark no-event. Exactly one immutable terminal domain event/outcome per logical create; generation created event alone must not be confused with later jobterminal.

Stable locator lookup excludes current contract/caller revisions, session/credential identity, workers/leases. OWNER_FULL stays stable across sessions/API key. Frozen accepted revision tuple stored separately. Replay digest based only canonical caller arguments/original target/CAS; executionDescriptorDigest adds server revisions/context and is retained from original record. Current revisions must not split retry into new operation.

UPDATE preserves component/runtime identities, RETRY retains approved functionalauthority and retries failed technical portion, REPAIR monitoringevidence retains identities/approved lineage, FOLLOW_UP creates new discussion branch/spec revision. Do not create simple universal parent-terminal enum allowlist: distinct kind admission predicates derive from these facts. Parent identity existence alone insufficient; frozen approved lineage/known failed work required RETRY, monitoring evidence required REPAIR. Exact active-parent branch policy absent.

15type enum and TYPE_SPECIFIC+NO_SILENT_NORMALIZATION are binding. Apart from audit-added UTF8/BASE64 transport, original sources do not define accepted cert/key/oauth/db/SSH/TOTP/session/cookie formats, fields, supported algorithms, emptyvalue acceptance or expiry semantics. Generic provider validation allowflag is not actual type semantic proof. Derive encoding validation without fabricating format policy; freeze unresolved format choices explicitly.

Initial request and sources immutable and persisted before model invocation; actual bytes and digest hydration precedes parsing, source RECEIVED vs VERIFIED distinguished. Atomic acceptance/queueoutbox required before HTTP202. Creation commit request/source/job/event/audit/outbox joins retained logicaloperation outcome; failed/unknown cannot emit created outcome; replay cannot allocate root/version/event again.
